gloss: to patch up; to keep up appearances; to gloss over

definitions.gloss: to patch up; to mend temporarily
definitions.explanation: To make quick repairs or fixes to something.

definitions.gloss: to keep up appearances; to gloss over
definitions.explanation: To hide problems or faults to maintain a good impression.

examples.japanese: {失敗|しっぱい}を{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}おうとしたが、バレてしまった。
examples.english: I tried to cover up my mistake, but it was found out.

examples.japanese: {体裁|ていさい}を{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}っても{意味|いみ}がない。
examples.english: There's no point in just keeping up appearances.

examples.japanese: {壊|こわ}れた{椅子|いす}をとりあえず{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}った。
examples.english: I patched up the broken chair for now.

examples.japanese: {破|やぶ}れた{服|ふく}を{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}って{着|き}ている。
examples.english: I'm wearing clothes that have been patched up.

examples.japanese: {雨漏|あまも}りを{応急|おうきゅう}{的|てき}に{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}った。
examples.english: I temporarily patched up the roof leak.

examples.japanese: {笑顔|えがお}で{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}っても、{本心|ほんしん}は{隠|かく}せない。
examples.english: Even if you put on a smile to cover it up, you can't hide your true feelings.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う → {取|と}り{繕|つくろ}わない (negative)
・{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う → {取|と}り{繕|つくろ}って (te-form)
・{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う → {取|と}り{繕|つくろ}った (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {取|と}る (to take) + {繕|つくろ}う (to mend)

USAGE:
・その{場|ば}を{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う (to smooth over the situation)
・{見栄|みえ}を{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う (to keep up appearances for vanity)
・{欠点|けってん}を{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う (to gloss over faults)

NUANCE:
Often implies superficiality or temporary fixes rather than addressing the real problem. Can have negative connotations of deception.
